title: Browser Agent
subtitle: A Chromium to open the app, capture it, compare its screens and run the E2E tests of every stack.

browser.idle: Browser is idle. Enter a URL and click Go to start.
browser.idleDescription: Enter a URL in the address bar above and click Go to capture a screenshot of the page.
browser.errorHint: Check that the URL is reachable and try again.

regression.noBaselines: Capture a screenshot in the Browser tab, then come back here to set it as a baseline for visual regression testing.

tests.noResults: Click "Run all tests": Playwright, Cypress, pytest, .NET, JUnit, Go, RSpec and PHPUnit tests are found in the project's E2E folders.

errors.fetchFailed: Failed to load browser agent data
errors.noProject: Select a project to use the Browser Agent

recorder.title: Record a test
recorder.description: Open a page in a browser window, do what the test should do, then export the steps as a Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or WebdriverIO test. Alt+click an element to check its visible text. Iframes and open shadow roots are recorded; the test waits for what each action caused (a page, a request, an element) instead of pausing.
recorder.recording: Recording: act in the browser window
recorder.truncated: The recording reached its limit of 300 steps; later actions were not recorded.
recorder.noSteps: No step yet. Start a recording and act in the browser window.

waits.hidden: waits for the loading indicator to go

suggestions.title: Suggested checks
suggestions.hint: What showed up right after an action. Keep a check to add it after that action; it is not in the test until you do.

recorder.reviewHint: A review card puts the test on its own branch, never in the project folder; a file is saved outside the project.
recorder.envVars: Set these environment variables before running the test: {{names}}
recorder.skipped: {{count}} step(s) have no selector this framework can express and were left as comments.
